row.evidence: Webex documents a SCIM 2.0 API (webexapis.com/identity/scim/{orgId}/v2) with Users, Groups, Bulk and Schemas endpoints and IdP guides for Entra, Okta and JumpCloud, but its pricing page (Free, Meet $144/user/yr, Suite $270/user/yr, Enterprise contact sales) does not say which plans include SCIM or SSO.
row.notes: New row. Unknown because SCIM is documented but no Webex page names the plan that includes it, and the product has several tiers (rule 1a); the feature comparison table on the pricing page lists no SSO, SCIM or directory-sync row. Prices are annual ($144/user/yr Meet, $270/user/yr Suite = $22.50/mo). SCIM tokens come from a Control Hub service app or an OAuth flow signed in as a full admin; manually generated tokens last 365 days. Entra: legacy Cisco Webex gallery app uses SCIM 1.1 (connector in Preview); Webex recommends a custom non-gallery app on SCIM 2.0. Groups sync only via the Entra ID Wizard app (Graph API). Removing a user from the IdP marks them Inactive; permanent deletion deletes the Webex user; content in spaces is kept. Directory Connector (on-prem AD sync) needs a trial or any paid subscription, which hints that admin sync is not limited to Enterprise, but that statement is about Directory Connector, not SCIM.

auth.token_source: Control Hub > Apps > Service apps > Get a token, or an OAuth implicit flow signed in as a full admin (scope identity:people_rw)

endpoints.notes: Paths seen in the API reference data: /identity/scim/{orgId}/v2/Users, /Users/{userId}, /identity/scim/v2/Users/me, /v2/Groups, /v2/Groups/{groupId}/Members, /v2/Bulk, /Schemas/SCIM2/User.

deprovision.data_retained: Removing or soft-deleting the user in Entra marks the Webex user Inactive (renamed); a permanent IdP delete deletes the Webex user. Content they created in spaces is not deleted and follows space retention policy.

filtering.notes: Search users takes a SCIM filter; sortBy allows userName, id, meta.lastModified.

custom.how: Cisco extension urn:scim:schemas:extension:cisco:webexidentity:2.0:User: accountStatus, sipAddresses, managedOrgs, managedGroups, extensionAttribute1-15, externalAttribute1-15

roles.how: roles attribute in the core schema and managedOrgs/role in the Cisco extension

rate_limits.text: Bulk requests are limited to 100 operations.

limitations.text: The pre-built Cisco Webex Entra gallery app uses legacy SCIM 1.1 and the Entra connector is in Preview; Webex recommends a custom non-gallery app for SCIM 2.0.
Groups, rooms and avatars sync from Entra only through the Entra ID Wizard app (Graph API).
JumpCloud: SAML SSO must be enabled to use SCIM; groups not supported.

auth.notes: Scope names read from the API reference data.

rate_limits.text: Polling /people for status quickly leads to 429 throttling; numeric limits not stated on the pages read.

okta.notes: OIN markup marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push).

entra.notes: Gallery connector in Preview, SCIM 1.1 (legacy); custom SCIM 2.0 app recommended by Webex.

google.notes: Webex documents SSO via a custom SAML app in Google Admin; no Google provisioning documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Directory Connector (on-prem Active Directory sync, trial or any paid subscription); Entra ID Wizard app (Graph API)
